Is there any risk for CKD?\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"background-color: #1c1c1c; clear: both; font-family: \u0026quot;Cormorant Garamond\u0026quot;; text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: white; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"background-color: #1c1c1c; clear: both; font-family: \u0026quot;Cormorant Garamond\u0026quot;; text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEhx4sOl65d4VrTrOY7rSp6VpXAM541NP9eh4robKUu_lj6FxgZq0bzqmMi4tpEi3vsP9I9d9E04g29cfbGSK1wlXAWai7HhVC-R6Ex5jEuv7fSHyZagA4048qNN-NIgkhwAhJLYaLog3y2nqdtXL_DTLt5hg1bgsca6LOAbqdjUzn7uZHW1wheoZ_49O3j7\/s1577\/IMG_6416.jpeg\" style=\"margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cimg border=\"0\" data-original-height=\"945\" data-original-width=\"1577\" height=\"192\" src=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEhx4sOl65d4VrTrOY7rSp6VpXAM541NP9eh4robKUu_lj6FxgZq0bzqmMi4tpEi3vsP9I9d9E04g29cfbGSK1wlXAWai7HhVC-R6Ex5jEuv7fSHyZagA4048qNN-NIgkhwAhJLYaLog3y2nqdtXL_DTLt5hg1bgsca6LOAbqdjUzn7uZHW1wheoZ_49O3j7\/s320\/IMG_6416.jpeg\" width=\"320\" \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"background-color: #1c1c1c; clear: both; font-family: \u0026quot;Cormorant Garamond\u0026quot;; text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: #1c1c1c;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: white; font-family: Cormorant Garamond; font-size: medium;\"\u003EPatients with bronchial asthma may have increased risk of developing chronic kidney disease. The use of steroids or non-steroidal drugs in the treatment of asthma may attenuate this risk\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: #1c1c1c;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #d0e0e3; font-family: Cormorant Garamond; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: #1c1c1c;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #d0e0e3; font-family: Cormorant Garamond;\"\u003Ereference\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-family: Cormorant Garamond;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #fff2cc;\"\u003E:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/24885269\/\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #ffe599;\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov\/24885269\/\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: black;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: white; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cu\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: black;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: white;\"\u003EQuestion 9.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: black;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: white; font-family: Cormorant Garamond;\"\u003EDoes bronchial asthma constitute a risk for the development of CKD? What are the factors associated with the development of CKD among asthmatic patients?\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/u\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: black;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: white; font-family: Cormorant Garamond;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: black; color: white; font-family: Cormorant Garamond; font-size: medium;\"\u003EGFR was significantly lower in asthmatic and development of CKD was higher among asthmatic patients.\u0026nbsp;Asthma is a type of chronic airway inflammation and proinflammatory cytokines have been shown to play a central role in the pathogenesis of asthma. The inflammation extends systemically.\u0026nbsp;Studies have shown increased levels of biomarkers of systemic inflammation (C-reactive protein and interleukin-6) in asthmatic groups\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: black; color: white; font-family: Cormorant Garamond; font-size: medium;\"\u003EThis systemic inflammation could have a significant effect on initiating and aggravating other disease processes, including kidney disease,\u0026nbsp;in which the cytokines and inflammatory mediators associated with asthma play a modifying role in renal disease.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: black; color: white; font-family: Cormorant Garamond; font-size: medium;\"\u003ETumor necrosis factor-α (TNF-α), a mediator of the acute-phase reaction of early inflammatory response, is considered to be a multifunctional cytokine involved in airway inflammation\u0026nbsp;and also increases airway contractility in asthma\u0026nbsp;In the kidney, TNF-α contributes to the chronic inflammation that often precedes interstitial matrix deposition and is also implicated in obstruction-induced renal injury . Serum levels of TNF-α have been shown to be elevated in patients with CKD, with a general increase with declining renal function\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: black; color: white; font-family: Cormorant Garamond; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: black; font-family: Cormorant Garamond; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: white;\"\u003Ereference:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/journals.lww.com\/aamj\/fulltext\/2017\/15010\/is_bronchial_asthma_a_risk_factor_for_chronic.6.aspx\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: #9fc5e8;\"\u003Ehttps:\/\/journals.lww.com\/aamj\/fulltext\/2017\/15010\/is_bronchial_asthma_a_risk_factor_for_chronic.6.aspx\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: left;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: black; color: white; font-family: Cormorant Garamond; font-size: medium;\"\u003E\u003Cu\u003EQuestion 10. He was apparently asymptomatic 10 days back , then he developed Shortness of breath which is insidious in onset, gradually progressive in nature, aggravating on exertion and relieved on taking rest, progressed from grade II to grade III- IV (Modified MRC)\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"clear: both;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: black; color: white; font-family: \u0026quot;Cormorant Garamond\u0026quot;;\"\u003EOrthopnea, Paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea present\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"clear: both;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"color: white; font-family: Cormorant Garamond;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: black;\"\u003EC\/O Bilateral pedal edema\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: black; caret-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: white; font-family: \u0026quot;Cormorant Garamond\u0026quot;;\"\u003Ebelow knees\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: black; color: white; font-family: \u0026quot;Cormorant Garamond\u0026quot;;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp;, facial puffiness and periorbital edema since 8 days , insidious onset, gradually progressive in nature , no diurnal variation, pitting type I.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp style=\"clear: both;\"\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: black; color: white; font-family: \u0026quot;Cormorant Garamond\u0026quot;;\"\u003EC\/o\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"background-color: black; caret-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: white;
